protocol: One process and one pinned logical CPU per model and fold. Fit wall time includes masking and default fitting. Timing starts from resident sparse features, excludes database I/O and scoring, and includes fresh predictions, defaults and consensus. Three repeated full-fold batch timings follow one warmup. Peak RSS is the process high-water mark through fit and prediction, including the interpreter and input data.
